name: Availity Essentials
short_description: Free multi-payer provider portal for eligibility, claims, claim status, remittances and authorizations with participating health plans.
long_description: Availity Essentials is the provider portal many health plans (including many Anthem/Elevance, Blue Cross Blue Shield and Highmark plans) sponsor, so it is free for providers. From one login you can check eligibility and benefits, submit professional claims, check claim status, view remittances, and handle authorizations and appeals where the plan supports it. What you can do depends on each payer. A paid Essentials Plus tier adds non-sponsoring payers. It is usually used alongside an EHR's own clearinghouse rather than instead of one.
one_liner: The free insurer portal for eligibility, claim status and authorizations.
best_for: Checking eligibility, benefits and claim status at no cost
Low-volume billers whose main payers sponsor Availity
Prior authorizations and appeals that a payer requires through Availity
A companion to an EHR's clearinghouse for payer-specific tasks
not_for: Practices with a mixed payer list that want one place to submit everything
Batch or automated billing workflows on the free tier
Clinicians who want billing done for them

notes.insurance-billing: The free portal many insurers require for eligibility, claim status, authorizations and appeals.
notes.budget: Free for providers with sponsoring health plans; a paid tier covers other payers.
notes.low-volume: A low-volume biller can submit claims to sponsoring plans by web form without buying a clearinghouse.

pricing.notes: Essentials is free for transactions with sponsoring payers. Essentials Plus (non-sponsoring payers) is paid; Availity does not currently publish its price.

seo.title: Availity Essentials
seo.meta_description: Availity Essentials review - free clearinghouse for 3M+ providers. Eligibility verification, claims status, prior auth. Connects to 95%+ of US payers....

faqs.a: Yes, Availity Essentials is completely free for healthcare providers. The service is funded through partnerships with health plans. Basic features like eligibility verification, claims status, and prior authorization are free forever.

faqs.q: What payers does Availity connect to?
faqs.a: Availity connects to health plans covering 95%+ of commercially insured patients in the US. This includes major payers like UnitedHealthcare, Anthem, Aetna, Cigna, and hundreds of regional plans.

faqs.q: What is the difference between Availity Essentials and Essentials Pro?
faqs.a: Essentials is free and includes manual eligibility checks, claims status, and prior auth. Essentials Pro adds automation, batch processing, advanced analytics, API access, and enhanced support for $100-300/month depending on volume.

faqs.q: Can I use Availity for mental health eligibility verification?
faqs.a: Yes, Availity works for all healthcare specialties including mental health. You can verify behavioral health benefits, check authorization requirements, and submit prior authorizations to most commercial payers.
